locationNotes: Source context and visible workshops establish Kumortuli on 2 October 2021, followed by the Hooghly riverfront. No exact ghat name is invented.

December festival signs explicitly identify the Kolkata International Film Festival. Earlier crowded shopping-street photographs keep the broader Central Kolkata label; later Apeejay House and Allen Park signs establish the Park Street sequence.
Pixel filenames encode UTC-like times but their EXIF DateTimeOriginal is the local evidence. Preserve the original calendar date and reported +05:30 offset where present.

criteria: Favor distinct scenery, architecture, art, craft, wildlife, food and daily life; omit most repeated posed portraits.
